rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Consistency
rules.statement: The system must not assign an order to a Store Partner if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot indicates insufficient quantity for any item in the request.
rules.condition: During order allocation when a customer submits a request with multiple items
exceptions: Items marked as 'Back in Stock' with a confirmed ETA within the delivery window
rules.if_violated: The order remains unassigned and is flagged for manual review to prevent overselling and customer dissatisfaction
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling which leads to order cancellations, financial loss, and eroded customer trust

parameters.name: minimum_available_quantity
parameters.description: The quantity required for each item in the order

rules.name: Delivery Proof Integrity
rules.statement: Funds must not be released to the Store Partner until a valid delivery proof containing a timestamp and signature is recorded in the system.
rules.condition: At the moment of Financial Settlement Handover confirmation
exceptions: Customer explicitly waives proof requirement via verified settings
rules.if_violated: The transaction is automatically reversed and funds are held in escrow pending manual verification
rules.rationale: Ensures the platform only pays for successfully delivered goods, mitigating fraud and operational risk

parameters.name: required_proof_elements
parameters.description: List of mandatory fields like timestamp and signature

rules.name: Regulatory License Validity
rules.statement: The system must block order allocation to a Store Partner if their primary operating license is flagged as invalid or expired.
rules.condition: During order allocation and at the start of each business day
exceptions: Temporary suspension due to administrative review with an approved override code
rules.if_violated: The Store Partner is immediately suspended from receiving orders until compliance is restored
rules.rationale: Maintains legal compliance and protects the platform from liability associated with unlicensed operations

parameters.name: license_expiry_threshold
parameters.description: Days before expiry to trigger a warning

rules.name: External Proof Verification Standard
rules.statement: Delivery proof retrieved via external API must be treated with the same verification standards as locally captured proof.
rules.condition: When validating delivery proof regardless of source
exceptions: API returns a specific 'pending verification' status defined in the integration contract
rules.if_violated: The delivery proof is rejected and the order status remains 'In Transit' or 'Pending Proof'
rules.rationale: Ensures data integrity and prevents fraud by standardizing verification logic across all data sources

parameters.name: verification_algorithm_id
parameters.description: Identifier for the standard verification logic applied
